headline: Eagles RT Lane Johnson To Retire
summary: Lane Johnson missed the Eagles’ Week 4 game for personal reasons. The organization has since announced a bombshell; the 14th-year right tackle is retiring in-season. headline: Tyreek Hill's wife recounts assault, verbal abuse at trial
summary: Tyreek Hill's wife recounted details of assault and verbal abuse during testimony Tuesday on the first day of a civil assault and battery trial in Florida, proceedings that began a day after ESPN reported Hill would potentially sign an NFL contract soon.

headline: Ravens TE Durham Smythe out for season with torn Achilles
summary: The Ravens will not have one of their veteran offensive contributors for the rest of the season.

headline: Cardinals signing Jedrick Wills, place Paris Johnson on IR
summary: With Paris Johnson Jr. out for the season with a torn biceps, the Cardinals have added a former first-round pick to their offensive line.

headline: Giants' Berrios says he'll undergo season-ending foot surgery
summary: Giants receiver Braxton Berrios will undergo season-ending surgery on his foot, he announced Tuesday on Instagram.
